evidence.observation: Growth hold at 750.2 °C against a 750 °C setpoint. The brief overshoot to 760.6 °C at t=2520 had settled by t=2760.
The ramp followed the setpoint within about 1 °C from t=840 onward.
Steady at about 45% during the hold, which fits holding a steady temperature after the ramp.
Ar flow matched the setpoint within 1 sccm throughout: 200 sccm during purge, 100 sccm during ramp and growth.
Controller has reported running at every event.

args.missing_evidence: There is no pressure gauge or exhaust O2 sensor, so a seal leak or exhaust blockage would not show up in this telemetry. There are also no reference ranges to check that 45% heater power is the normal hold level, which would help rule out thermocouple drift. Characterization of the sample is still needed.
